lines.t: Ooh, falling through the shadows again
Trying to hold my soul together
Heaven, hear me tonight
Carry me through the storm
Late night riding with the bread on my chest
Mind moving fast but I still need rest
Dark clouds hanging while I fight through fear
Searching for peace while the pain's staying near
Every road cold, every memory burned
Still got faith while the whole world turned
Lost too much, trying to carry my pride
Now I'm down on my knees with my hands in the sky
Monsters keep calling, trying to pull me low
But grace keep flowing, let the river still flow
I was trapped in the dark where the sorrow grow
Now the light break through when the wind blow
When the wind blow
I can feel your love around me
Through the darkness
You're the only peace that found me
Every scar, every broken bone
Let me closer to you so
When I'm cold, I still know
I'm not alone
Tryna heal from the battles inside
Here's a pain that I used to hide
Tears falling while I stare at the sky
Wondering why I survived this life
Still breathing, still standing tall
Even when the world want me to fall
Mercy came when my faith got weak
Now the lost part of me finally free
Pressure heavy but my spirit rise
Truth cut deeper than the enemy lies
Always running too fast from the voice in my soul
Now I finally feel whole
Carry me, wash away the fear inside of me
Hold me close when the night don't sleep
Let your peace fall over me
Seein' too many people lose they way

Praise God, more for love
When the wind blows, I can hear heaven calling.

Every chain, every heavy load ain't mine.
Don't hold no more when the storm comes.
I still know what I'm fighting for.
To guide my soul through the night
Lead me toward the light
Lead me toward the light
Thank you.
